balls.text: full outside off stump once again, Morkel can't get under it and drives towards long off for a single to end the innings
fantastic ball, in the block hole outside off stump, Dhoni can't do much but drive towards cover
Morkel stands in his crease and drives the ball hard to long-on, it reaches the fielder on the bounce, no boundary yet in the final over, two to go
good length delivery on middle and off, Dhoni pulls the ball towards midwicket
Pathan bowls the slower short ball, Dhoni winds up to pull but is far too early on the shot, he gets hit on the body, a priceless dot ball
Albie tries to launch the length ball over midwicket, the line is outside off and he gets an inside edge behind square
Hopes bowls a low full toss outside off stump, Dhoni comes out of his crease and throws his bat at it, he connects and hits the ball to Sreesanth on the sweeper boundary
once again it's full and nearly in the block hole outside off, Dhoni manages to wind up and drive the ball powerfully past Yuvraj at cover for four
a full toss outside off stump, Morkel moves forward and drives towards deep cover, Hopes is concentrating on keeping it in the block hole outside off stump
Dhoni tries to play the paddle sweep to a full ball but mis-times it once again
Dhoni's launched that! it was a length ball on off stump, Dhoni plants his front foot forward and smashes it over long on for six, he reaches 50 and that's Chennai's first boundary for 20 balls
bowled full and wide outside off stump, Dhoni lets it go and that's a wide
Dhoni drives a full ball from off stump towards wide third man, Sreesanth does well to save the boundary
Dhoni moves outside the line of off stump and tries to play the paddle sweep, he misses it and gets only the leg bye
Morkel clears his front foot out of the way and tries to smash VRV over midwicket, he mis-times it towards square leg
short of a length on middle stump, Morkel pulls off the front foot through midwicket for two
caught! just reward for some lovely death bowling, Badrinath backs away and tries to loft the yorker over cover, he mis-times it and hits it straight to Yuvraj who takes a sitter at cover
once again the length is right up there in the block hole, Dhoni can't get under it and drives towards long on
excellent length from VRV in the block hole outside off stump, Dhoni swings and misses, Punjab are pulling this back
full ball wide outside off, Badrinath reaches for it and tries to drive through point, he misses, superb over from Hopes, Punjab have strung together two economical overs at the death
Badrinath tries a cheeky paddle shot over short fine leg but the length is full outside off stump, he gets beaten
excellent length, in the block hole, Dhoni hits it hard into the ground and the ball bounces over Hopes' head
fuller length on off stump, driven off the front foot towards long off, Hopes has begun this over well
tight line and length on off stump, Dhoni flat bats the ball towards long off
Dhoni moves down the pitch, Hopes bowls the ball full on off stump, Dhoni squeezes it towards wide third man for two, Chennai go past 150
Sreesanth jogs in off a really slow run up and bowls a low full toss on middle and leg, Dhoni flicks to deep square leg, excellent over for Punjab, only five off it
excellent ball in the block hole outside off stump, Badrinath digs it out behidn point
a good length ball angles into middle stump, Dhoni drives off the front foot to long off
banged in short by Sreesanth, Dhoni shapes up to hook but lets it go in the end, the umpire doesn't call it wide
Badrinath backs away towards leg to make room and hit over extra cover, Sreesanth's line and length is good, nearly in the block hole, and Badrinath mis-times the drive towards the leg side
short of a length outside off stump, Dhoni cuts off the back foot towards third man
now he makes room by moving towards leg, stays on the back foot and lofts the ball over wide mid-off for four more, amazing improvisation

what a shot! Badrinath moves back in his crease, waits for the full ball to come to him, clears his front foot out of the way to make room and drives the ball hard down the ground, the ball is so well struck that it beats long-on
short of a length outside off stump, Dhoni moves forward and cuts the ball through cover, just the single once again, tight over so far from VRV
that's a fast full toss, Dhoni stays in his crease and drives towards mid-off
Badrinath makes room and drives another full ball from his stumps through point for a single
full ball on off stump, Badrinath makes room by moving towards leg and drives towards Yuvraj at cover, he mis-fields and lets the ball go past him, the ball seemed to turn away from him
Badrinath reaches fifty by pushing the ball towards point off the front foot, the MA Chidambaram stadium rises to applaud a terrific innings from the local boy
driven firmly off the front foot towards long on
cut off the back foot towards cover
Dhoni clears his front foot out of the way and smashes the ball down the ground with a flat bat, such power behidn the shot
Badrinath waits for the tossed up delivery and pushes the ball towards point, Dhoni sprints through for  a single, the throw hits Dhoni on the arm
bowled flat on middle and leg, Dhoni moves down the pitch and drives hard to long-on
full ball outside off stump, Dhoni moves forward, reaches for the ball and hits it with a flat bat towards long-on
driven off the front foot through cover for  a single
that's too short and at Pathan's pace it's an easy hit, Badrinath rocks back and pulls the ball flat over the deep midwicket boundary, Punjab are bleeding runs
defended on the front foot towards the off side
he's got plenty of elevation this time! Badrinath moves across his stumps, moves forward and lofts the ball high over mid-on, he's got enough on it to clear the boudnary
Badrinath moves forward and towards the off side and drives the ball towards midwicket, he was looking to go airborne but didn't get any elevation
the slower ball sprayed wide outside off stump from over the wicket, that's another wide
Badrinath steps out of his crease, Hopes bowls a shorter ball and Badrinath pulls towards deep midwicket, just the single this time
the slower ball wide outside off stump, Badrinath moves towards leg as well, he reaches out for it and hits it to point
pulled away to deep midwicket for two more, the pace is frantic now
terrific shot! Badrinath sees the length is a bit short, he moves towards the leg side to make the room and cuts the ball hard through point for four
banged in short down leg side, Badrinath misses the hook, Kaul appeals for a caught behidn but the umpire calls it wide
driven firmly off the front foot towards long off for  a single
Dhoni steps out to Hopes this time and punches a short of a length ball through cover
Badrinath defends on the front foot, Chennai are 100 for 3 after 11 overs, they look good for a lot more
pushed off the front foot towards point for one
Dhoni advances once again but Chawla alters the length and Dhoni has to defend towards the off side
bowled flatter through the air on middle stump, Dhoni cuts through cover off the back foot
and again! Dhoni gets down the pitch and lofts the ball back over Chawla's head for another six! He hit that flat but it went rather far
Dhoni charges again and once again he gets to the pitch of the ball and smashes him into the gallery at deep midwicket, they better mind it, he's hitting it hard and far
clever! Badrinath sees that the fine leg has been brought up, he moves across his stumps and paddles the ball from middle stump over the man at short fine leg for four
Dhoni moves forward and drives the ball towards long-off for  a single
Hopes gets the ball to bounce sharply on Dhoni from just short of a length, he plays the ball towards point
Badrinath moves forward and makes room by moving towards leg, he runs a short of a length ball down to third man with an open face
Dhoni tries to flick the ball on the leg side and gets hit on the pad, they run a leg bye towards the leg side, Hopes runs across to try and prevent it but can't
good length delivery angling into middle stump, defended on the back foot towards the leg side
Dhoni waits on the back foot and cuts a flat ball through point
Badrinath tries to drive the ball off the front foot through cover but gets an inside edge on the leg side, that was the googly from Chawla
driven hard down the ground to long off for a single
he's clobbered that! Dhoni steps out of his crease, gets to the pitch of the ball, and smashes it into the stands at wide long-on, that went several rows back
flighted delivery outside off stump, Badrinath gets to the pitch of the ball on the front foot and drives the ball elegantly through cover
bowled slowly through the air on off stump, Badrinath leans forward and defends
Dhoni tries to drive a good length delivery through cover but gets an inside edge on to his pad
a short of a length delivery angles into Badrinath, cramping him for room, Badrinath opens the face off the back foot and runs the ball towards third man
good length from VRV outside off stump, the ball moves away from Badrinath who drives away from his body and gets beaten
Dhoni moves forward and across and uses the angle into him to flick the ball through the gap at midwicket, he sprints two and then sprints harder for the third
VRV pitches on a good length and slants the ball into the right-hander, Dhoni moves back and across and defends towards point
VRV gets the ball to bounce sharply from just short of a length, the ball climbs on Dhoni who drops his wrists at the last moment
tossed up outside off stump, Badrinath defends on the off side on the front foot

caught! Chawla shortens the length and Raina attempts the mighty slog over deep midwicket, he gets a top edge that goes high in the air towards point where Marsh takes the catch, Chawla's broken a partnership that was steaming along
Badrinath drives the ball towards long off for one more, Chennai are speeding along at nearly ten an over
bowled full and flat on middle stump, driven down the ground for  a single
Raina pushes hard at the ball and the outside edge runs towards third man for four more
Raina comes down the track and swings hard to send the ball over midwicket, he hit that flat and has placed it in the gap
bowled flat through the air down leg side, Raina lets it go and that is another wide
Raina moves across his stumps and flicks a good length delivery off his pads towards midwicket for a quick single
a good length delivery slants into the right-hander's off stump, Badrinath drives off the front foot towards wide mid-off for a single
good length delivery on off stump, Rania defends on the front foot towards point
VRV strays down leg side and that is another wide, Raina wants a bye as well but scampers back to his crease
defended on the front foot

Badrinath cashes in! long on and long off are back so VRV bowls the full ball, Badrinath waits in his crease, moves a shade across his stumps and lofts the ball high and far over deep midwicket, superb hit
VRV's over-stepped to there's a free hit coming up, Raina plays the ball behind square for one run
short and wide outside off stump, Raina stays in his crease, gets under the ball and cuts it over the in field to send the ball speeding to the cover boundary
classy! Badrinath takes a step towards leg to make room and lofts a full delivery straight back over Sreesanth's head for four
the length is a bit too full from Sreesanth and Badrinath moves forward and flicks the ball over the infield at midwicket and scores his first boundary
Badrinath tries to make room by moving towards the leg side, Sreesanth bowls a good length delivery angling into the right-hander, Badrinath pushes the ball in front of point for one
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Raina moves back and drops the ball with soft hands towards the off side and calls for the quick single
Badrinath tries to flick but gets hit on the pad, they steal a leg bye
Raina moves on to the back foot and punches the ball towards mid-off for a single, well fielded
a good length ball straightens into the right-hander after angling across him, defended on the front foot towards the bowler
Badrinath waits on the back foot and cuts a short of a length delivery into the small gap between point and backward point
that is too wide outside off stump, Punjab have been generous with the wides today
the length isn't short but Raina tries to pull and forces it towards mid-on where VRV runs to his right and fields, Badrinath is watching the ball and responds late to Raina's call
tight line and length from Pathan on off stump, Raina defends off the back foot towards the bowler
Badrinath moves forward and steers a good length delivery from outside off stump towards third man with an open face
good length delivery on off and middle stump, defended on the front foot towards the off side
driven back past the bowler for  a single to end the over
fuller length on off stump, driven firmly off the front foot towards Yuvraj at mid-off
excellent length just outside off stump, making the batsman drive off teh front foot, the ball moves a shade away from Badrinath and beats the bat
good length delivery outside off stump, played with an open face towards point off the front foot
short and wide outside off stump, it was extremely wide, the umpire signals a no ball at first

caught! Fleming moves forward to a good length ball outside off and tries to drive on the up, he's hit it very hard but the ball goes straight to Karan Goel who takes a sharp catch at cover, that ball was travelling at great speed
fullish length just outside off stump, Fleming strides forward and drives towards cover
that's hit with a lot of power, the ball is short and wide and Raina cuts the ball hard through cover point for four
that's just a bit short and Raina rocks back to pull the ball over midwicket, he hasn't timed it well so the ball won't reach the boundary
good length delivery outside off stump, Raina defends on the back foot towards point
a short of a length ball pitches outside off and moves away from Raina who stands on the back foot and tries to cut the ball over point, it's too wide and the extras column goes up by one
Pathan gets the ball to seam away from the left-hander quite a bit, Raina begins to play at it but pulls his bat out of the way
this time the line is a bit too straight which allows Fleming to work the ball off his thigh behind square, he's off the mark
he pitches the ball on a good length and seams it away from the left-hander after angling it into him, Fleming strides forward and lets the ball pass
good length delivery on off stump to end a rather long and eventful over from Sreesanth, Rania defends the last ball off the back foot towards cover

Rania's off the mark in rather strange fashion, Rania moves forward to drive a full ball and hit it right back at Sreesanth who stuck his boot out to stop the ball, he goes down in pain and the ball rebounds through midwicket, the batsmen take two

caught! Vidyut flirts with one too many outside off stump, the length is good and the line is wide outside off, Vidyut throws his bat hard at the ball, looking for the drive through cover, he gets a thick outside edge that speeds towards Jayawardene who takes a sharp catch to his left at first slip
smashed! Vidyut leans forward, reaches for the full and wide ball outside off stump and drives it in the air over point for four, he hit that with a lot of power and it travelled quickly
shot! Sreesanth's line is closer to off stump and the length is too full, Vidyut strides forward and cover drives into the gap to collect his first boundary
wide outside off stump, Vidyut chases it for the third time and misses the cover drive, it was too wide and the umpire calls it again
Vidyut has another dash at a wide ball that slants across him, this time umpire Jayaprakash calls it wide
short of a length delivery pitches outside off and slants across the left-hander from over the wicket, Vidyut stays in his crease and slashes but gets beaten
the Super Kings win! Balaji ends the game with a slower ball on a good length which Uday Kaul misses

he's got the hat-trick!!! Balaji bowls a short ball outside off stump, VRV backs away and throws his bat at it, the top edge goes straight to Dhoni and the Super Kings mob Balaji! He's thrilled and everyone's gathered around him, amazing scenes and Chennai are roaring on their local lad
Balaji's got another one! Chawla backs away and lofts a full ball in the air towards long-off where Kapugedera takes an easy catch, Balaji has four, can he take five?

caught! and that is that! Balaji bowls a slower ball just short of a length, Pathan pulls off the front foot and lofts the ball straight to Raina at deep square leg, he's gone and taken Punjab's hopes with him
that's a slower ball and Pathan has pulled it towards deep midwicket where Raina dives to save the boundary
that's a huge hit! Balaji bowls a full toss which Pathan has pulled over deep square leg for a six!
Chawla tries to move outside the off stump and paddle the ball to the fine leg boudnary, Morkel bowls a slower one and Chawla gets beaten
fantastic bowling, right up there in the block hole, Pathan drives off the front foot towards long off, Punjab need a boudnary a ball now
Chawla makes room and drives another ball from the block hole towards cover for just the single
excellent ball, in the block hole on middle stump, Chawla digs it out back to the bowler
full ball on middle and off, pushed towards midwicket for one
he's smashed it! Pathan gets under a length ball and lofts it high and far over long-on, they need 16 an over and Pathan's already got six of them.
full ball on off stump, Chawla backs away and lofts the ball expertly over extra cover, four more to end the over
Chawla backs away towards leg to make room and cuts the short ball hard and over point, the ball bounces on the rope and the third umpire tells the on-field umpire that it's six
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Pathan pulls once again but hits it along the ground to midwicket
Pathan aims for the fans at deep midwicket but mis-times the slog, he manages to clear the in-field though but gets only two
short of  a length delivery slants across Pathan who slashes hard but misses
Pathan lofts Gony straight back over his head, he's hit it cleanly and the ball clears the boundary with ease
tossed up on middle stump, Chawla drives hard and straight and Murali dives to his right to cut it off, he's finished his spell and it's been a brilliant one for Chennai
defended on the front foot towards point
a full toss on leg stump, Pathan swings hard and places the ball in the gap at deep backward square leg for four
driven off the front foot through cover
this time he does make contact and his attempted hit over midwicket ends up as a leading edge that falls safely between mid-on and mid-off
Chawla tries to sweep from leg stump but can't make contact
full ball on middle stump, Pathan drives firmly but straight back to the bowler, Balaji goes for four off his third over
flicked off the pads through square leg for one
that's shrewd bowling, Balaji follows up a couple of fast bounces with the fuller slower one, Chawla mows across the line and gets comprehensively beaten
banged in short once again, Chawla throws everything at it while trying to pull but can't connect
Chawla mis-cues the ball high in the air but it falls safe past the cover region
another short ball and Chawla backs away and swings wildly, he gets beaten but the umpire signals a wide
Balaji bowls a sharp bouncer which smacks Chawla on the grill of the helmet

Murali's got him! Jayawardene goes on the front foot and tries to hit over midwicket once again, Murali's length is a little shorter and it was the doosra, the top edge flies over Dhoni's head for Vidyut who moves from short third man and takes a simple catch, Murali is delighted
Murali retorts with a short and fast ball outside off, Jayawardene tries to cut but gets beaten
Jayawardene's hit him for six! He moves across his stumps, gets into position and lofts the ball with the spin over deep midwicket, elegant shot
full delivery on the pads, Pathan flicks past the fielder at short fine leg
bowled flat and straight, Pathan moves forward and defends to the bowler
Jayawardene moves back and cuts the ball behind point for  a single
that's streaky! Pathan tries to drive a good length ball that seams away from him off the front foot, he gets an outside edge that evades Dhoni's full length dive and runs to the third man boundary
he's smashed it! Amarnath pitches short and Pathan dispatches the ball towards deep midwicket with a fierce pull
Jayawardene moves on to the back foot and opens the face of the bat to run the ball towards third man
the good length ball jags into Jayawardene who gets hit on the body, he tries to run but Amarnath reaches the ball quickly and prevents the single
good length ball on off stump, pushed off the front foot towards cover for one

caught!! Yuvraj is gone, the ball is short and wide outside off stump, Yuvraj stands on the back foot and cuts hard, the ball flies quickly towards point where Fleming jumps up and takes a sharp catch, Chennai erupts and begins to sing "We will rock you" as Yuvraj departs, that may well be the end of Punjab's challenge tonight
Yuvraj jumps on to the back foot and works the ball off his hips for  a single behind square, Balaji has taken two wickets and given away only two runs off that over, awesome

caught! That is a vital wicket, Balaji bangs the short ball and Marsh tries to pull off the front foot, the ball gets to him quicker that expected and Marsh top edges the ball in the air to Amarnath who runs in from deep square leg to take the catch
bowled full in the block hole just outside off stump, Yuvraj drives the ball behind point for a single to third man
that's a clever slower ball outside off stump, Yuvraj backs away a fraction and throws his bat at it, he gets beaten once again
banged in short outside off stump, the ball bounces high and beats Yuvraj's half-hearted poke off the back foot

bowled him! Sarwan jumps down the track and tries to pull Balaji, the length isn't short enough and the ball beats the cross-bat swipe and crashes into middle stump, Sarwan hadn't hit a boundary and was evidently feeling the need to get a move on

they need a new ball! Marsh goes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and swings Murali high and far over deep midwicket, that is on the roof and umpire Jerling immediately calls for more balls, fantastic strike
Marsh moves towards leg side to a flat and quick one on middle stump, it was the doosra and Marsh just about got bat on it
Sarwan moves his front foot across and sweeps Murali down to long leg for one, they aren't able to get him away
defended on the off side
Sarwan jumps out of his crease and Murali and drives hard and straight, Murali dives to his left and fields superbly
Marsh clears his front foot out of the way and tries to slog Murali through midwicket, he doesn't time it well
pushed off the front foot towards cover
Marsh plants his front foot forward and lofts Balaji through the line and sends the ball sailing over the long-on boudnary, he brings up his 50 with that six, he's such a clean hitter of the ball
Sarwan moves across his stumps and gets beaten by a slower ball that raps him on the pad, Balaji appeals but that is too high, the batsmen run a leg bye
full ball in the block hole outside off stump, Marsh digs it out towards third man for a single
another slower ball on a good length, angling into the right-hander, Sarwan pushes towards cover and calls for one
starts off with a slower ball outside off stump, Marsh comes forward and drives towards long-off for a single
Marsh moves back in his crease and punches the ball through midwicket for the single, eight of Murali's first over
Sarwan moves his front foot across and glances Murali from middle and leg towards long leg
Sarwan moves on to the front foot and chips Murali over cover for two more
Murali strays on to leg stump, Sarwan moves across and sweeps to long leg where Vidyut dives and saves the boundary
Sarwan moves back and across and plays a flat ball from off towards midwicket
bowled flat and fast on leg and middle, nudged off the pads towards midwicket
Marsh moves across his stumps to sweep and Murali slips down leg side, wide called
short again and Marsh gets on to the front foot and pulls towards deep midwicket for a single, he wants the second and begins to come back but Sarwan says no, the throw comes to the keeper's end
the length is just a bit short and Marsh pulls the ball with one leg in the air to deep square leg, that was more of a short arm jab
that has gone miles! Marsh plants his front foot toward and tees off, he takes advantage of the fuller length and creams the ball straight back over the bowlers head
better length, pitches around off stump and moves away from the left-hander, Marsh fends and gets beaten
terrific shot! The length is too full and allows Marsh to get under it, he lofts through the line and hits the ball over the long-on boundary, punchy shot and with a hint of Yuvraj in it
good length from Amarnath on middle and off stump, defended on the front foot towards point
width offered outside off stump, Marsh drives off the front foot and hits the ball hard to the fielder on the sweeper boundary
tight line and length on off and middle, Sarwan pushes towards long-on for a single
Marsh uses the angle into him and works the ball off his pads behidn square for one more
that's deft, Sarwan waits for the good length ball outside off and cuts it late towards third man
Sarwan once again moves across his stumps and whips the ball off his pads through square leg for two more
strays on to leg stump with his first ball, Sarwan moves across and flicks off his pads behind square for two
Sarwan leans across his stumps and flicks firmly towards midwicket where the fielder dives and cuts off the boundary, he doesn't stop it cleanly however and concedes the single
Amarnath strays on to middle and leg, allowing Sarwan to flick into the gap at midwicket, the batsmen come back for two
too full once again outside off stump, Marsh leans forward and drives fluently towards long off
crisp shot! The length is too full on leg stump, Marsh leans across and flicks the ball with lovely use of his wrists over square leg for four
good length delivery on off stump, Sarwan drives towards Murali at mid-off and this time he misses the stumps at the bowler's end
too full on leg and middle, Marsh leans across and flicks towards midwicket for one
good length delivery angling into off stump, Sarwan drives off the front foot towards cover
short of a length outside off stump, Marsh moves on to the back foot and runs the ball off the face of the bat towards third man
a bit too straight from Morkel, Sarwan moves forward and flicks off his pads through square leg
Marsh gets on to the front foot and drives firmly to Murali at mid-on, he runs the single but Murali once again charges in, picks up cleanly and throws down the stumps at the bowler's end
good length on off stump, Marsh pushes the ball towards cover and wants the single, Rania sprints in and prevents it
short of a length delivery angling into the rib cage, Sarwan nudges the ball off the back foot towards square leg
Sarwan waits on the back foot and runs a good length ball down to third man, two runs and a wicket off that over, Gony's bowled a gem
slightly over-pitched outside off stump, Sarwan moves forward and times the cover drive well but hits it straight to the fielder
Gony's length pushes Marsh on to the back foot and he works the ball with an open face behind point for a single

caught at third man! Gony pitches the ball just short of a length and angles it across the left-hander, Goel tries to play the upper cut and hits it with no real power, the ball goes straight to Morkel at third man who takes a simple catch
good length delivery on off stump, Goel defends off the front foot towards point, the asking-rate is inching up towards 10 an over
fuller length on off stump, Goel strides forward and punches the ball firmly to Murali at mid-off, they want the single but Murali fires the throw back quickly
Morkel gets the ball to bounce a bit more from a good length and goes past the outside edge of Marsh's back-foot push
excellent ball, pitches on a good length and seams across the left-hander, Marsh pokes at it and gets beaten
short of a length once again outside off stump, Goel moves back and cuts past the fielder at point
short of a length delivery angles across the left hander, Marsh waits on the back foot and plays it with an open face towards third man where the fielder slips and allows the third run
once again he tries to drive through the off but mis-times the ball towards mid-on
Marsh moves forward to a full ball outside off stump and lofts the ball uppishly but in the gap through cover for four
fuller length outside off stump, Goel strides forward and drives towards point
tight line and length on middle stump, Goel gets behind the line and blocks
defended on the front foot towards the leg side
Marsh drops the ball with soft hands on the off side for the quick single
Marsh strides forward and lofts a good length ball on the up, he hits through the line and clears mid-off, lovely timing
Marsh comes on the front foot and drives firmly towards mid-off
caught! Morkel bowls a short of a length ball down leg side, Hopes tries to glance the ball towards the fine leg boundary but feathers a nick through to Dhoni who takes an easy catch
Hopes backs away towards leg and drives a good length ball on the up through covers, he hit that firmly but Vidyut dives to his right and saves runs
Marsh comes forward and tries to drive through cover, he mis-times it towards Murali at mid-on and steals the single
short of a length delivery pitches outside off and slants across the left-hander, Marsh sees the width and slashes but gets beaten by the extra bounce
Hopes backs away to make room and guides the ball towards third man for one
a bit too full on the pads, Hopes walks across and flicks the ball towards long leg for two, fine leg is in the circle so deep backward square leg has to field
good length delivery on middle and off, Marsh comes forward and drives towards mid-on, 12 runs off the first over
fuller ball in the block hole, Hopes plays the ball towards mid-on for one
shot! Gony follows the short ball with the over-pitched one outside off, Hopes stays in his crease and punches the ball firmly through cover for four
that's the first six! Hopes backs away towards leg, makes room for himself and upper cuts the short ball over third man, Hopes has a strike-rate of 600!
nice shot! Marsh leans forward and punches the good length ball firmly towards mid-off and calls for the single, Murali hits the stumps direct at the bowler's end but Marsh was home
begins with a full ball on middle and off, Marsh moves forward and drives the ball firmly towards mid-on
